description: This file defines the 'ContentType' interface within the 'Todaymade\Daux\ContentTypes' namespace. It specifies methods related to content processing, including retrieving supported file extensions and converting raw content into output format.

classes.name: ContentType
classes.description: Interface for content type classes, requiring methods for construction, extension retrieval, and content conversion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the content type with a configuration object.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Returns an array of file extensions supported by this content type.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts raw text and a Content node into the output string.
